name: Gibeonites
overview: The Gibeonites are depicted in Scripture as a people who employed cunning to secure a covenant with Israel, presenting themselves as travelers from a distant land with worn-out clothes and provisions to gain favor (Joshua 9:4-9). Their approach led Joshua and the Israelites to make a league with them, demonstrating both the Gibeonites' strategic wisdom and Israel's willingness to honor their commitments despite initial deception.
